title: Music folder
whyItMatters: The Music folder holds the local music library and downloaded tracks, including purchases tied to the person's Apple account.
source: Apple macOS User Guide, folders in your home folder (Music)
notes: Counts files and total size only; no track or playlist is opened. A library stored on an external drive is not covered. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
